doors.note: Wix Events site. The page's own warmup blob carries the event list (one item: the weekend pass) with scheduling.config start/end/timeZoneId, location (Birmingham, UK) and the Wix event page slug; the visible page also prints the nights' ticket links (Dandy on OutSavvy, BEEFMINCE on DICE). No JSON-LD events, only a WebSite node.
The linktree he sent: links to bearbrum.com, /guide (404) and the festival's Instagram/Facebook. Nothing of its own.

Live read 2026-10-17 (one curl, 981 KB). The Wix events widget still carries exactly one item, the 2026 pass (past). Visible text: "…then after a bit of a rest, we will look at what 2027 bring for Bear Brum." — nothing upcoming is published.

Page cache 2026-10-14 (run 20261017-054812 read it). The weekend schedule as prose: "FRIDAY 25th SEPTEMBER Welcome Event The Fountain Inn 5pm - 7:30pm … The Hub: Eden - 10pm - Late DANDY returns … SATURDAY 26th SEPTEMBER Midsbears Market Eden Bar 11am - 4pm … The Hub: Eden - 10pm - Late It's BEEFMINCE … SUNDAY 27th SEPTEMBER Bears Do Breakfast Boston Tea Party 11am - 1pm …" — ten dated, timed, placed items, all past. The run's two kept records came from this page's outbound TICKETS links (DICE for BEEFMINCE, Outsavvy for Dandy), not from the schedule text.

recon.notes: Recon from one cached read of the site on 2026-09-22. Bear Brum is Birmingham's bear festival, 25–27 September 2026. 2026-09-29: the festival has taken place; the home page now opens with a thank-you note and its Wix events blob still carries the one record (BEAR BRUM WEEKEND PASS, 25 September 2026 at 17:00 – 27 September 2026 at 21:00), now past. Runs 20260927-125246 through 20260929-091555 read 0 from this source for the same reason as Xposure Events: a connection failure during a network outage had been cached as a permanent failure of the configured url.

coverage.basis: Feed door: every item in the Wix events blob (one). The festival publishes one dated record — the pass — and hands the nights to other promoters. Re-read 2026-10-17: still the one pass in the Wix blob, now past; the /events page keeps the 2026 schedule (10 items, counted not enumerated) and the home page says the next edition is 2027. The run's place-missing record is the Outsavvy Dandy page (reader bug, see door), not this site.

openQuestions.q: The /events page publishes the festival's own ten schedule items (Welcome Event at The Fountain Inn 5pm–7:30pm, Midsbears Market at Eden Bar 11am–4pm, Beary Bingo …) as prose with venue and clock, while the Wix feed carries only the pass. Next edition: should those be documented (and extracted) as the festival's events, or does the pass stand for the weekend?
